newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ispat Industries net falls-PTI. [CORRECTED 01:00 GMT 2/7]
newsitem.headline: India Ispat Industries net falls-PTI. [CORRECTED 01:00 GMT 2/7]

text.p: Indian steel firm Ispat Industries Ltd has reported a net profit of 788.3 million rupees in 1996/97 (April-March), down from 1.0 billion rupees in the previous year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.

Turnover rose to 13.9 billion rupees (corrects from 1.39 billion rupees) from 13.7 billion (corrects from 1.37 billion), the news agency said. The company's board of directors recommended a dividend of 15 percent on the shares, it said. PTI did not state the dividend for the previous year.
